verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published VRAM capacity or memory-bandwidth figures for the B200 GPU itself, nor any explicit statement about running a 70B-class quantized model locally; it only offers generic performance multipliers (3X training, 15X inference) and unrelated DGX system details (power, health monitoring, networking). Community comments mention B200 being 'better than H200' and convenient for SMEs but give no concrete memory specs or quantized-model inference data. missing for 10: published VRAM capacity per GPU, memory bandwidth spec, any benchmark or claim about running a 70B quantized model on a single B200/node.
